Name: Terror Inc
Description: Centuries ago on Earth-88194 (Also known as Shadowline ) the man who was to become Terror Inc. was a brave knight during the middle-ages. He had a wife he loved and was respected by his people but also feared. However, during one of his crusades, this man killed a gruesome demon. By slaying this demon, he was cursed. He soon found out his flesh began to rot, and spikes grew out of his face similar to ones on the demon. His wife and loved ones became terrified of him. For this, he took the name Schreck (German for "fright"). He left his family to wander the earth. It was at this time that he found out that he could assimilate body-parts into to his own body if the need arose.
